title: How onmywatch Works
meta: plugin for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor · 0.31.0 · github.com/dip497/onmywatch

lead.answer: onmywatch is one plugin of 11 skills that three coding agents read from the same folders.
points: Two skills load in every session; the others start when you or the agent call them.
Only the Claude Code files are edited by hand. A script writes the rest.
Each skill has evals that score it with and without the plugin.

panels.title: One root folder serves all three hosts.

tree.sub: one plugin, one marketplace per host

`always-on.sh` loads two skills at session start
name and version: the only manifest edited by hand
test cases per skill, run with `claude plugin eval`
